tagline: A prediction credibility layer for agents building forecast features.
firstCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py explain-fit --goal "add predictions to my app"

helpsWith.label: Resolvable forecast contracts
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Turns vague prediction ideas into future-facing questions with horizons and resolution rules.

helpsWith.label: Evidence provenance
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Records which source roles and forecast-time evidence supported a prediction.

helpsWith.label: Baseline comparison
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Keeps new methods honest by comparing them against simple baselines before stronger claims.

helpsWith.label: Resolution and scoring
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Separates forecast-time evidence from outcome evidence and scores resolved forecasts.

helpsWith.label: Calibration gates
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Blocks calibration and quality claims until enough comparable resolved outcomes exist.

helpsWith.label: Agent-safe readbacks
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Gives agents compact commands and schema-bound records instead of free-form oracle output.

doesNotProvide.label: Frontend or dashboard
doesNotProvide.replacement: Build UI in the host app and render OPE forecast cards.

doesNotProvide.label: Hosted API
doesNotProvide.replacement: Use local CLI, in-process calls, agent-call, or local MCP until a transport is checked.

doesNotProvide.label: Trained model out of the box
doesNotProvide.replacement: Bring a model and compare it through OPE method and scoring gates.

doesNotProvide.label: Generic web crawler
doesNotProvide.replacement: Provide approved sources or checked adapters under source policy.

doesNotProvide.label: Production scheduler
doesNotProvide.replacement: Use host scheduling; OPE only exposes checked local readbacks today.
